verdict.rationale: The only documented recovery behavior is for infrastructure failures: a lost board, hotspot or mirroring link pauses the run and resumes it from the same step. Nothing describes how the agent handles unexpected popups, screen/state drift, or failed taps, and no retry policy is documented. missing for 10: documented handling of popups and dialogs, state-drift detection and re-planning, retry limits or behavior for failed actions, independent or hands-on corroboration of recovery.
